decision.explanation: The ceramic serving bowl from order O0037 was delivered broken (damaged). It is within the 10-day return window for home category items. The item price is ₹399, under ₹500, but since no photo evidence is provided as required for items over ₹2,000 only, this is fine. As damaged item refund requires a return pickup scheduled first (E5), return is scheduled. Refund will be processed automatically after pickup completion. User will be asked for explicit confirmation for this action.
